@implementation Calculator

- (int)sumTo:(int)n {
    int total = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        total += i;
    }
    return total;
}

- (int)countDown:(int)n {
    int steps = 0;
    while (n > 0) {
        n--;
        steps++;
    }
    return steps;
}

- (int)safeDivide:(int)a by:(int)b {
    @try {
        return a / b;
    } @catch (NSException *e) {
        return 0;
    }
}

- (int)classifySwitch:(int)value {
    switch (value) {
        case 1:
            return 10;
        case 2:
            return 20;
        default:
            return 0;
    }
}

- (int)pick:(BOOL)flag x:(int)x y:(int)y {
    return flag ? x : y;
}

- (BOOL)checkBoth:(BOOL)a and:(BOOL)b {
    return a || b;
}

@end
